note: Town of Pincher Creek campground at 940 Lawrence Street (signed from Hwy 6 / Waterton Avenue), beside Pincher Creek and the town walkway system, near town amenities. On-site host; gates close at 11 pm. Tent sites T1 and T2 are walk-in only. Showers and the water fill and dump are for campground guests only. --Claude
summary: Town page read: 7 full-service + 11 electric + 4 tent = 22 sites (was 20), C$45/C$40 (tent C$30), online booking via PerfectMind plus drop-ins, flush toilets, free showers, on-site water fill and dump. Page now says 'Closed for the Season' (seasonal, no dates published). Riverview kept.
